summary: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report advises on the feasibility of reducing the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Lawson Road between Port Union Road and the Highland Creek Overpass.
decided: Scarborough Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40km/h on Lawson Road, between Port Union Road and Highland Creek Overpass.
